items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: In the 20s I believe we had Art and Hale.

ctx.x: Who were some of the other clarinet players in town in the 20s?

Well I don't know. In the 20s I believe we had Art and Hale. Here we had Jimbo. Yeah Jimbo was out here in the 20s. Now here we had Johnny Hunnicall. Johnny Dots. Johnny Dots. We had Pills. And uh. Had this other boy Zeb. Had Zeb. Then this boy Joe Watson. Had him. And uh. Kaiser. We had Kaiser. We had Georgie boy.
What kind of a clarinet player was Georgie Boyd? John Boyd was a pretty good clarinet player. Would you say he had a rough style?
